decisions.reason: This niche two-component glass flake spraying system still fits the firm's core coating and spraying business, so a Mittelstand machinery producer would usually keep it unless demand proved clearly insufficient.
The low-pressure injection pump is a close extension of the established portfolio and was prominently marketed, making continued support the most likely choice.

A low-pressure material transfer pump line with several models represents a meaningful product-family commitment in the firm's core application equipment range and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat more adjacent than the pump and spraying products, but it supports the firm's push toward interoperable customer solutions and is still more likely to be retained than dropped.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is a recent launch close to the firm's established offer, so dropping it after a short market period would be atypical for this kind of engineering-led manufacturer.
